svg.title: Black Curve XI
svg.desc: Schematic visual study after the cited photograph. Approximate geometry and interpretive colors; wall and cast shadows omitted. Full-resolution reference establishes the white painted field on a rectangular canvas. White field retained; only the surrounding wall is omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of black, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
